provenance.source: in-process Worker fetch handler (src/index.ts), keyless, upstream https://api.ko.io
provenance.note: Captured from the Worker built from this working tree by calling its fetch handler in process (the same JSON-RPC bodies wrangler dev serves). Each case was probed twice and written only because the two probes agreed. Every EU market was pending at capture (2026-10-12).

cases.name: normal
cases.why: The per-market status table. Cells are table body (collapsed), the legend line is constant, so this contract survives activation unchanged.

lines: THEAD Market | Insider dealings (PDMR) | Major holdings | Net short positions | Annual reports
TEXT *live = served; pending = offered but not activated yet (not an outage, not empty); not offered = a fixed source/licensing decision.*
TEXT *UK: rows credit the filer and the National Storage Mechanism. Its terms allow no link to an individual record, so ko.io gives none (`source.url` is null).*

cases.name: error
cases.why: Input schema is `{}`: an unexpected argument is dropped and the normal answer comes back -- pinned for the same reason as get_crypto_exposure.error.
